newsitem.title: USA: Teledata sees sales of lead product rising.
newsitem.headline: Teledata sees sales of lead product rising.

text.p: Teledata Communications said Thursday it expects sales of its new DCS-20E product will continue to increase during the next few quarters, which should have a positive impact on its gross margins.
The company said sales on the product have been the primary driver in its increased sales.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.30, compared with $0.15 for the same period a year ago. Sales rose to $20.6 million from $11.9 million.
The company said the DC-20E is a system that allows telephone companies to connect more customers to their local exchange.
